blocks.tamil_translation: of Shaytan,” said Rasulullah ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- If a person says, “If I had done this, such and such would have happened,” and his purpose in this is to rely on his own plan contrary to Taqdir and to think that there is no such thing as Taqdir, then using such words is forbidden. For on such an occasion Shaytan gets the chance to remove the belief he has in Taqdir (and push him into kufr).
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:أَلَا وَإِنَّ الرُّوحَ اْلاَمِينَ نَفَثَ فِي رُوعِي أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ تَمُوتُ حَتَّي تَسْتَوْفِيَ رِزْقَهَا، فَاتَّقُوا اللهَ وَأَجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ، وَلَايَحْمِلَنَّكُمْ اِسْتِبْطَاءُ الرِّزْقِ أَنْ تَطْلُبُوا بِمَعَاصِي اللهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يُدْرَكُ مَا عِنْدَ اللهِ إِلَّابِطَاعَتِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو طرف من الحديث) شرح السنة للبغوي:٣٠٥/١٤، قال المحشي رجاله ثقات وهو مرسل.
blocks.tamil_translation: “No soul will die until it has fully received its (fixed) rizq (provisions). So fear Allah. Adopt a pure way in seeking (rizq). Let not the delay in getting rizq drive you to disobey Allah in seeking rizq. For (your rizq is with Allah.) What is with Allah can be obtained only by obeying Him! Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) placed this message into my heart (by the command of Allah),” said the Prophet ﷺ. Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَضَي بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ
